summary: [standards] The PLAN_STALE half of test 09 does not isolate what the brief asks (the plan state names the form of each object): the late plain object also changes the summed object bytes the plan already carried before this change, so the test stays green if the per-form `forms` string is dropped from the Reads set. A form swap with an equal byte total is the case the new state is for and no test covers it. Blast radius: the plan digest of artifacts prune on an object-store tier.
